summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Leads feature separation from Opportunities. Backend APIs and frontend UI are working correctly with minor cache issue in unfiltered dashboard stats.

medium_priority_bugs.issue: Cached dashboard stats don't include separate counts for leads and opportunities (total_leads, new_leads, qualified_leads fields missing)
medium_priority_bugs.impact: Unfiltered dashboard view doesn't show leads stats. Filtered views work correctly.
medium_priority_bugs.details: The rebuild_cache function in dashboard_agg/routes.py (lines 185-342) doesn't separate leads from opportunities. It treats all records as opportunities. The filtered stats endpoint (lines 409-413) correctly separates them. Cache rebuild needs same logic.
medium_priority_bugs.workaround: Use filtered dashboard view (with any filter) which calculates stats in real-time and correctly separates leads from opportunities

passed_tests: GET /api/leads/stats - returns stats (total_leads=203, new_leads=0, qualified_leads=0, conversion_rate=0.0%)
GET /api/opportunities - returns 100 opportunities, all type=opportunity (no leads mixed in)
GET /api/dashboard/stats?year=2025 - filtered stats correctly show total_opportunities=363, total_leads=141
POST /api/leads/{id}/convert - successfully converts lead to opportunity
Leads stats cards display (Total Leads: 202, New Leads: 0, Qualified: 0, Conversion Rate: 0%)
Leads list view shows 100 leads in table
Convert lead button opens dialog and confirms conversion
Filter persistence: year=2026 filter persists from dashboard to leads page
Filtered leads page shows correct count (5 leads for year=2026)
Search functionality on leads page works
Opportunities page displays only opportunities (no leads)
Dashboard with year=2025 filter shows filtered data correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix dashboard cache rebuild function to separate leads from opportunities. Update rebuild_cache() in /app/backend/services/dashboard_agg/routes.py (lines 185-342) to use same logic as filtered stats endpoint (lines 409-413): separate records by type field and calculate separate stats for opportunities and leads.
